title: European Flags Quiz: 20 Flags to Identify
description: Identify 20 flags of Europe, from Belgium and Poland to Malta and Montenegro, in this free quiz. Test your eye for European flags.
h1: European Flags Quiz: Can You Name Them All?
intro: Europe has a long tradition of flags, and many of them share the same colors, stripes and crosses. This European flags quiz shows you 20 national flags, one per question, and challenges you to pick the correct country. You will begin with well-known designs such as Belgium, Poland and Greece, then move on to Nordic crosses, Baltic tricolors and Balkan flags that are easy to mix up. The final questions feature Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Moldova and Montenegro. You have about five seconds for each, so go with your gut. A short explanation after each answer shares a fact about the flag.

faq: Why do so many European flags have three stripes?

The tricolor style spread across Europe after the French Revolution, when the French tricolor became a symbol of liberty. Many countries, including the Netherlands, Germany, Italy and Hungary, adopted horizontal or vertical stripes in their own colors. Others, like Ukraine and Poland, use just two bands, while the Nordic countries chose crosses.

A Nordic cross, or Scandinavian cross, is a cross with the vertical line shifted toward the hoist. It appears on the flags of Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland and Iceland. Denmark's Dannebrog is believed to be the oldest, dating back to the Middle Ages.
Which European flags are the most similar?

The flags of Romania, Chad and Andorra are close, as are Slovakia, Slovenia and Russia. In the Balkans, Serbia, Croatia and Slovenia use similar colors, and in the Baltics, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania all use horizontal bands that are easy to mix up.
